label: Peptide fragment
description: A portion of a larger naturally occurring peptide or protein.

label: Peptide analogue
description: A modified peptide designed to alter stability, potency or duration relative to a natural sequence.

label: Peptide secretagogue
description: A peptide that stimulates release of an endogenous hormone.

label: Peptide mixture
description: A preparation containing multiple peptides rather than a single defined molecule.

label: Peptide-derived compound
description: A compound derived from a peptide structure but substantially modified.

label: Small molecule
description: Not a peptide. Grouped with peptides in some references because of shared clinical context, but chemically and pharmacologically distinct.

label: Not yet classified
description: Compound class has not been established from a source.
